title: Bigu grammar content
description: Shape of a data/grammar.json file, as loaded by grammar.js.

level.description: JLPT level this file covers, e.g. "N2".

id.description: Unique id, e.g. "gr-001". Used as the progress-store key.

pattern.description: Grammar pattern text; grammar.js renders it after a 〜.

patternKana.description: Optional furigana reading for `pattern`, shown only when `pattern` contains kanji. Omit for kana-only patterns.

structure.description: Formation rule, e.g. "Verb (dictionary form) + わけにはいかない".

notes.description: Optional usage note in Mongolian; grammar.js only renders this row when present.

tags.description: Optional JLPT-level facet tags for the grammar view's category chips. If omitted, grammar.js falls back to the file's own `level` as the point's only tag.

points.structure: Verb (nai-form, minus ない) + ざるを得ない

example.jp: 体調が悪いので、休まざるを得ない。
example.reading: たいちょうがわるいので、やすまざるをえない。
example.mn: Бие эрүүл мэнд муу тул амрахаас өөр аргагүй.

points.notes: Албан ёсны бичгийн хэлэнд түлхүү хэрэглэгддэг.
